newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian agency suggests state fund change.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian agency suggests state fund change.

text.p: Australia's Grants Commission on Tuesday recommended revised national funding for the country's six states and territories, proposing a reallocation towards the two most populated states, New South Wales and Victoria.
The commission, which oversees federal grants to the states and territories, said its recommendations for reallocating national funds stemmed from changes to state economies and populations.
The commission said its recommended changes, the smallest since 1992, assumed unchanged total funding.

But it said the final figures could be different because the national government had pledged to maintain real funding and possible reforms from the meeting of state and federal leaders and treasurers later this year.
